Key terms: - Microorganisms = நுண்ணுயிரிகள் | Very tiny living things. - Bacteria = பாக்டீரியா | A type of microorganism. - Virus = வைரஸ் | A very tiny microorganism. - Fungi = பூஞ்சை | A group of microorganisms. - Yeast = ஈஸ்ட் | A useful fungus that helps bread rise. - Algae = அலகி | A type of microorganism that can live in water. - Protozoa = புரோட்டோசோவா | A type of microorganism. - Microscope = நுண்ணோக்கி | A tool used to see very tiny things clearly. - Useful = பயனுள்ள | Something that helps us. - Harmful = தீங்கு விளைவிக்கும் | Something that can cause harm. - Curd/Yogurt = தயிர் | Food made with help from good bacteria. - Bread rises = ரொட்டி உயருகிறது | Bread becomes bigger and soft with help from yeast. chunks.text: Topic: Microorganisms Source: SAINS T6 SJKT.pdf Generated by AI-EZAM source converter. Common misconceptions and correction guidance: - Wrong idea: all small things are microorganisms. Correction: a microorganism is a tiny living thing, not just any small object. - Wrong idea: air is a microorganism. Correction: air is not a living thing. - Wrong idea: all microorganisms are harmful. Correction: some are useful, such as yeast and good bacteria. - Wrong idea: insects like ants are microorganisms. Correction: ants are visible animals, not microorganisms. - Wrong idea: virus is not a microorganism. Correction: viruses are treated as microorganisms in this Year 6 topic.

Learning-mode and practice questions: - What are microorganisms? - Why do we need a microscope to see microorganisms? - Give two examples of microorganisms. - Is bacteria a microorganism? - Is a bird a microorganism? Why? - True or false: All microorganisms are harmful. - Which one is a microorganism: bacteria, tiger, rock, or mango tree? - Why is air not a microorganism? - Which microorganism helps bread rise? - Give one example of a useful microorganism.
